gloss: the member these asks were put to

a cycle that put an ask or a sample no cycle before it put, numbered after every cycle the record holds, and the mode of orior_klq_identity it ran; the asks and samples below it, to the next cycle, are the ones it put, in the order it put them, and a cycle the record answered whole writes no line
the seed the cycle above drew the order of its links of one magnitude from, KLQ_SEED, where its mode draws one
the round of the cycle above that put the asks below it, in the pair mode, where it put one no cycle before it put

every untimed ask put to the member, by the hash of its code, the registers, shape and launches it was put with, its count of cases and the hash of its cases, and what came back: answers and the word of every case in the order of the cases, or illegal, nothing, timed_out or censored and the refusal: timed_out where the watchdog ended it before it came back, a question a later cycle asks again until it resolves, and censored where the gate held it off the member to protect the whole, the gate's reason its refusal, and the member never saw it

every timed ask, put each time it is asked and each time a sample of its own, by its identity as an ask's, and what came back: answers and the nanoseconds its launches took together on the member's own timer, then where the carrier timed each launch alone the least and the most one launch took, its block latency, the runs P6 reads; or illegal, nothing, timed_out or censored and the refusal

a path read off the asks above: a pair of the bridge, the hash of what its put reads, its two forms' texts, the engine's chains and the host's answers, and its verdict, closed [<address>] <case> or open <count>. A closed pair whose reads are as they were is settled and put no more; an open pair, a pair with no path and a pair whose reads changed are gray, and the gray pairs are the queue a cycle puts

the run's table whose rows a record a run keeps is a view of: every record it holds and every record kept after a row, as krep_records.oracle.tsv gives a row, and the record written as its rows put it together
the word of every case came back, in the order of the cases
the member answered illegal, and the refusal is its own
the member left nothing, and the refusal says how
the watchdog ended it before it came back, a question a later cycle asks again until it resolves
the gate held it off the member to protect the whole, the gate's reason its refusal, and the member never saw it
